senses.gloss: m. (preced.) he that cuts the vines, i.e. he that advances money on the grapes on the vines; in gen. he that buys produce in the field; [Rashi: he that advances seed grain to be returned in new grain].—Pl. constr. שַׁבָּשֵׁי.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 73a:9">B. Mets. 73ᵃ</cite> <he>שַׁבָּשׁי שִׁבְשָׁא</he> Ar. a. Rashi (ed. <he>דשַׁבְשֵׁי שבשא</he>, Ms. H. <he>דמְשַׁבְּשֵׁי</he>, v. <cite ref="U00186"><he>שְׁבַשׁ</he></cite>.)
